address: Küçükyalı Sahil, Cumhuriyet Caddesi No:2, Küçükyalı/Maltepe, Istanbul, 34840, Türkiye

tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Istanbul residents come to this sun-drenched upscale restaurant to escape the hustle and bustle of the city. The waiters give expert advice on the wide selection of mezze in the display fridge – the salads are beautifully aromatic! And that's just the beginning, because the traditional preparation methods accentuate the rich flavours of super-fresh fish and seafood. Whatever you choose from the menu, the chef will cook it according to your wishes: sea bass, for example, grilled to juicy perfection and served with al dente vegetables. No unnecessary frills; just ingredient-led cuisine that never fails to impress. A reliable favourite!
